summary.headline: The Southborough Cultural Arts Council reviewed 33 grant applications and voted to allocate all $8,809 in available funds to grants.
summary.summary: The Southborough Cultural Arts Council met to conduct its initial review of FY27 grant applications. Members reviewed 33 grant requests totaling over $33,000 against an available budget of $8,809.43. The council voted to allocate the entire available amount to grant awards rather than reserving 5 percent for administrative expenses. Several applications were approved in concept, others were rejected or flagged for follow-up, and final dollar awards will be decided at the December 3 meeting.

topics.title: Routine business
topics.summary: The council approved meeting minutes and addressed administrative matters. Technical setups regarding council email and shared document storage were also reviewed. The meeting was adjourned at 8:00 PM.
key_details: Meeting called to order at 5:29 PM.
Minutes from the October 22 meeting were approved.
Discussion held on setting up shared town Microsoft 365 cloud storage.

topics.title: FY27 grant budget and administrative allocation
topics.summary: The council reviewed its available grant funds for FY27 and discussed accounting reconciliations from the prior year. After accounting for prior encumbered funds, the council confirmed a total grant budget of $8,809.43. Members voted unanimously to allocate all available funding directly to grant awards rather than withholding 5 percent for internal administrative expenses.
key_details: Total grant funds available for FY27 equal $8,809.43.
Funding consists of $6,500 from the state Mass Cultural Council and $2,309.43 remaining from town funds.
Town funds must be expended by June 30.
Council chose to forgo reserving roughly $320 to $440 for administrative costs or receptions.
topics.outcome: Approved unanimously to dedicate all $8,809.43 to grant awards.

topics.title: FY27 grant applications initial evaluation
topics.summary: The council conducted an initial screening of all 33 applications received for the FY27 grant cycle, categorizing each into supported, rejected, or pending follow-up. Applications requesting funding for events outside town without clear local benefit, or those that duplicated prior grants, were rejected. Applicants categorized as preliminarily supported accounted for approximately $8,100, positioning the council to finalize specific dollar amounts at its next meeting.
key_details: Council received 33 grant applications totaling approximately $33,000 in requests.
Messiah Community Chorus application was disqualified because the event was already funded in a prior grant cycle.
Follow-up questions regarding venues, dates, and budgets were assigned for applicants Manorama Choudhury, Michelle Lou, and StoryBridge.
The council agreed to support the Southborough Historical Society concert series rather than a separate duplicate application from Claflin Hill.
Grant amounts will be finalized on December 3.
topics.outcome: Applications categorized into approved, rejected, and follow-up lists for final decision.

votes.motion: To allocate all available FY27 funds of $8,809.43 to grants without withholding administrative funds

public_comment.summary: A representative of the Southborough Tricentennial Committee and Friends of Summer Nights addressed the council regarding a $5,000 grant request, explaining the funds would provide shade tents, tables, chairs, and accessible facilities for an expanded seven-hour concert event in August.

upcoming.what: Cultural Arts Council meeting to finalize grant award amounts
